title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Production Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kanakapura. This role oversees daily production operations to ensure output meets quality, safety, and delivery standards. Responsibilities include organizing and monitoring production schedules, coordinating resources and materials, and aligning team activities with production plans. The Production Supervisor guides and supports production staff, conducts shift briefings, resolves operational issues, and enforces safety and compliance procedures. The role also involves tracking performance metrics, identifying process improvements, and collaborating with management to meet production targets and optimize efficiency.
 



  





**Job Summary** 

  
 




  





 The Production Supervisor will oversee daily operations of the offset printing and packaging department, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety protocols are met. This role involves managing shop\-floor staff, coordinating with other departments, and driving continuous improvement in press and packaging operations.
 
  
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 

  
 




**Production Planning \& Execution** 

  
 



* Plan, schedule, and supervise daily offset printing and packaging operations to meet production targets and delivery deadlines.
* Allocate manpower, machines, and materials efficiently across shifts.
* Monitor job progress and resolve bottlenecks in press runs, finishing, and packing lines.



  





**Quality Control** 

  
 



* Ensure printed and packaged products meet quality standards (color accuracy, registration, finishing, packaging integrity).
* Conduct regular quality checks and coordinate with QC teams to minimize rejections and rework.
* Investigate quality complaints and implement corrective actions.



**Team Supervision** 

  
 



* Supervise, train, and motivate press operators, packaging staff, and helpers.
* Assign duties, monitor performance, and conduct shift briefings.
* Manage attendance, discipline, and performance evaluations of team members.



  





**Machine \& Process Management** 

  
 



* Oversee offset press operations (e.g., sheet\-fed/web offset), die\-cutting, folding, binding, and packaging equipment.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules with the maintenance team to reduce downtime.
* Optimize processes to reduce waste, material costs, and cycle time.



  





**Safety \& Compliance** 

  
 



* Enforce workplace safety standards and ensure proper use of PPE.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO standards, and statutory regulations.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard\-free production floor (5S practices).



**Reporting \& Coordination** 

  
 



* Maintain production records, downtime logs, and shift reports.
* Coordinate with planning, procurement, design/pre\-press, and dispatch teams for smooth workflow.
* Report daily/weekly production output, efficiency, and issues to management.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* Diploma/Degree in Printing Technology, Graphic Arts, Packaging Technology, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of offset press operations, pre\-press workflow, and post\-press/packaging processes.
* Familiarity with color management, ink/substrate properties, and finishing techniques (lamination, die\-cutting, folding, gluing).



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 

  
 




  




* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities on the shop floor.
* Knowledge of production planning and lean manufacturing/5S practices.
* Basic computer skills (MS Office, ERP/production software).
* Effective communication skills for cross\-department coordination.
* Ability to work in shifts and handle production pressure.



  





**Working Conditions** 

  
 



* Factory/shop\-floor environment; may require standing for extended periods.
* Rotational shift work, including weekends/holidays as per production needs.

title: Environmental Services Manager

 Primary Responsibility The Environmental Services Manager (EVS) is responsible for ensuring that all three assigned hospitals consistently achieve the highest standards of cleanliness, infection prevention, patient satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and frontline employee development. This role serves as the leader, coach, trainer, and quality assurance for Environmental Services (EVS) across three hospitals.

**Responsibilities** 




  




* Leadership and Team Management
* Provide leadership for EVS teams across the three hospitals.
* Conduct daily huddles with each hospital supervisor and communicate priorities based on the activities of the day.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, professionalism, and service.
* Maintain positive relationships with hospital administration, doctors, nurses, leadership, and department directors.
* Lead by example and support frontline teams when needed.
* Ensure adherence to set forth Cleaning/Infection Prevention Standards Core Values and "Cleaning for Health" philosophy.
* 
* Mission
* Protect patients, staff, and visitors through scientifically validated cleaning and infection prevention practices while developing people and creating a culture of excellence across all three hospitals.
* 
* Key Expectations for the Operations Manager Over Three Hospitals
* People
* Lead 40–100\+ EVS associates.
* Develop supervisors and trainers.
* Maintain a culture of accountability and service excellence.
* 
* Training
* Serve as the Train\-the\-Trainer Leader.
* Conduct monthly education sessions.
* Ensure 100% competency validation and documentation.
* 
* Infection Prevention
* Partner with Infection Prevention departments.
* Champion Cleaning for Health principles.
* Utilize ATP and UV monitoring to validate outcomes.
* 
* Quality
* Maintain quality scores above 95%.
* Achieve high patient satisfaction ratings.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* 
* Compliance
* Maintain survey readiness every day.
* Always ensure regulatory compliance.
* 
* Infection Prevention Leadership
* Serve as the EVS Infection Prevention Champion by:
* Preventing Healthcare\-Associated Infections (HAIs)
* Ensure cleaning processes support reduction of HAIs.
* Follow CDC, OSHA, and Joint Commission requirements.
* Collaborate with Infection Prevention and Nursing departments.
* Participate in Infection Prevention Committee meetings when requested.
* Promote cleaning for health, not cleaning for appearance.
* 
* High\-Risk Area Oversight
* Provide oversight for:
* ICU
* NICU
* Emergency Department
* Operating Rooms
* Isolation Rooms
* Oncology
* Dialysis
* Labor \& Delivery
* Patient Rooms
* Public Areas
* 
* Verify Cleaning Effectiveness
* Utilize:
* ATP monitoring
* UV light/marker validation
* Fluorescent gel inspections
* Visual inspections
* Corrective action programs
* 
* Chemical Compliance
* Ensure:
* Proper disinfectant selection
* Correct dilution ratios
* Required dwell times
* SDS compliance
* Safe chemical handling procedures
* 
* Training and Staff Development
* Train\-the\-Trainer Program Leader
* Develop and maintain site trainers and team leaders.
* 
* Responsibilities
* Train supervisors and lead technicians to become trainers.
* Conduct onboarding training for new employees.
* Teach:
* Standard precautions
* Transmission\-based precautions
* PPE requirements
* Bloodborne pathogen safety
* Hand hygiene
* High\-touch surface disinfection
* Color\-coded microfiber systems
* Isolation room cleaning
* Terminal cleaning procedures
* 
* Ongoing Education
* Provide monthly education on:
* Infection prevention updates
